rooms.name: The pond
rooms.text: Rain from the roof fills it. At blue hour it holds the whole house.

rooms.name: The porch
rooms.text: A larch deck, a lantern and an oak door as tall as two people.

rooms.name: The hearth
rooms.text: A limestone fireplace under oak trusses, eight metres up.

rooms.name: The long window
rooms.text: One pane of glass, the height of the house, faces the ridge.

rooms.name: The study
rooms.text: The house has its own story. Keep scrolling.
